sources.author: Harrison Chase
sources.headline: Co-founder & CEO @ LangChain
sources.post_summary: Discussed the rapid evolution of AI agents, highlighting how multi-agent systems are moving from experimental prototypes to production-ready workflows. Emphasized the importance of memory, tool use, and orchestration layers in building reliable agents.

sources.author: Swyx
sources.headline: Founder @ Latent.Space | AI Engineer
sources.post_summary: Shared insights on the current state of AI infrastructure, focusing on the shift toward specialized runtimes and inference optimization. Argued that developer experience tooling is becoming the key differentiator for AI platforms.

sources.author: Simon Willison
sources.headline: Co-creator of Django | AI & Data Consultant
sources.post_summary: Posted about practical automation using LLMs for developer workflows, including code generation, testing, and documentation. Highlighted real-world examples of how small teams are leveraging AI agents to 10x productivity.

sources.author: Clem Delangue
sources.headline: Co-founder & CEO @ Hugging Face
sources.post_summary: Talked about open-source AI infrastructure trends, particularly around model serving and agent frameworks. Stressed the growing importance of standardized agent protocols and evaluation benchmarks.

sources.author: Alex Hormozi
sources.headline: Founder @ Acquisition.com
sources.post_summary: Discussed how modern GTM teams are replacing traditional SDR roles with automated outbound systems. Shared a framework for building outbound automation that combines intent data, personalized sequences, and AI follow-ups to increase reply rates without increasing headcount.

sources.author: Elena Verna
sources.headline: Growth Advisor | Former CMO @ Amplitude, SurveyMonkey
sources.post_summary: Explained how content strategy should be treated as a core GTM motion rather than top-of-funnel marketing. Shared examples of how product-led content and customer education sequences can reduce CAC and improve sales velocity when integrated into revenue operations.

sources.author: Rick Nucci
sources.headline: Co-founder & CEO @ Guru
sources.post_summary: Broke down how sales ops teams are evolving into 'GTM engineering' functions. Highlighted the shift toward building internal tooling, data pipelines, and automation layers that connect marketing, sales, and customer success into a unified revenue system.

sources.author: Kasey Jones
sources.headline: GTM Engineer | Founder @ RevSure
sources.post_summary: Shared a case study on implementing outbound automation for a Series B SaaS company. Covered how they used buying signals, enrichment, and multi-channel sequences to generate 3x more qualified meetings while cutting manual outreach by 60%.

sources.author: Tomasz Tunguz
sources.headline: VC @ Theory Ventures | Former Redpoint
sources.post_summary: Analyzed how top-performing companies are restructuring revenue operations around data and automation. Argued that GTM engineering roles are becoming critical for scaling efficiently, especially as teams look to reduce reliance on headcount growth.

sources.author: Alex Finn
sources.headline: Solo Founder | Building AI tools in public
sources.post_summary: Shared his journey building and launching an AI writing assistant over 90 days as a solo founder. Detailed the product decisions, user feedback loops, and how he reached 1k users without funding or a team.

sources.author: Priya Sharma
sources.headline: Ex-Marketer turned Software Engineer | Career Pivot Stories
sources.post_summary: Documented her transition from marketing to full-stack development over 10 months. Highlighted the specific projects that helped her land her first dev role and the mindset shifts required during the pivot.

sources.author: Marcus Chen
sources.headline: Indie Hacker | Shipping side projects weekly
sources.post_summary: Posted about launching his third micro-SaaS in 2024, including the tech stack, pricing experiments, and early revenue numbers. Focused on the lessons from previous failed launches.

sources.author: Elena Rodriguez
sources.headline: Founder @ BuildSpace | Helping developers ship faster
sources.post_summary: Shared insights from mentoring 200+ solo developers on their first product launches. Covered common failure points and the frameworks she teaches for validating ideas before building.
